finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The code does not show any direct command execution, but the use of pthread_create with a lock variable as the thread ID is unusual and could indicate a mistake or misuse.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.assumptions: The 'name' parameter is attacker-controlled and could be longer than 50 characters, leading to a buffer overflow.

finding.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
finding.assumptions: The code initializes a reader-writer lock without any parameters, which might indicate a lack of proper configuration or hard-coded credentials.
